name: Social Auth Roles
description: Assign roles to users created via Social Auth.
project_description:
Social Auth Roles allows Administrators to use an interface to decide what Roles to automatically assign new users created with Social Auth.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 This modules adds a path /admin/config/social-api/social-auth/roles . You'll see a list of roles existing in your Drupal instance. Select which roles you want assigned new accounts on creation via Social Auth.

 Back to top 

 Example use case 
 All employees of a company use Google Accounts. You've limited Google login to _JUST_ the company's domain. And when new users are created via Google Accounts, you want them given the Employee role. Any accounts made traditionally via Drupal are not affected by this module.

 Requires 
 Social Auth
